Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin

Class AppContext

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.AppContext
public class AppContext extends Object
Manual dependency-injection container: wires DAOs into services once, at startup.

This is the only place that knows which DAO implementations are used. Services only depend on DAO interfaces, so they can be unit tested with mocks, and controllers get their services from here instead of creating them. Swapping SQLite for another database would only change this class.

The fields are public and final: they are set once in the constructor and never change.
